audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Shen rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 and called row 1 'Skill', while every matching why on the same page says Ryze wins those stages (whys[1] 'you are rooted before your E resolves', whys[3] 'keeping him ahead in an attrition war', whys[5] 'avoid direct trades', whys[6] 'the stronger late-game unit in a direct 1v1'). Row 0 was given to Ryze although whys[0] says neither side can force a trade.
audit.why: Shen's 53.04% here comes from Stand United map pressure, not from winning the 1v1 — the packet chart and the already-audited mirror both give Ryze the lane outright, with row 0 even. The page was rendering the opposite of its own prose.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Skill (5/10); rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 -> Ryze (3/10). Row 4 already Ryze and matches the mirror. Proposed as matched full+content pairs plus their ratings, as one atomic chart group.

audit.why: Spikes are right in substance: Rune Prison plus the Overload reset chain at 2-3, Stand United at 6, Seraph's Embrace, then full-build Ryze with Realm Warp. The array is out of chronological order (Lvl 6 sits at spikes[0]) but the 'when' labels are correct and re-ordering would rewrite four entries for no reader gain.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] told you to 'W-block his big auto window' against a champion whose damage is entirely spells — Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so it does nothing to Overload, Spell Flux or Rune Prison. The page also never mentioned that Rune Prison cancels Stand United mid-channel, and never said the root is conditional on Flux.
audit.why: Riot's W text is 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — an attacks-only filter. Riot's Rune Prison text: it damages and slows, 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted' — so the lockdown needs his E first, and that root lands on your R channel, which the kit flags as interruptible.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now states W blocks his autos only, never Overload; dontsFull[0].d and report[5].t now carry the Rune Prison / Stand United channel interaction and the Flux precondition; dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns carry the real 615 range and 11s->9s cooldown.
sources: brief ownerKit W/R text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns described Rune Prison only as 'matchup-defining' with no numbers.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the advice actionable: 11s at rank 1 falling to 9s, against Shadow Dash at 18s and Stand United at 200s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with all three real cooldowns and the Overload-reset note.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page warned that his root interrupts your ultimate.
audit.why: Stand United is a 200-second channel at rank 1; losing it to a single W is the most expensive mistake available in this lane.
